posts.body_html:
Man, this is wayyyy overdue. Mike!! I am so sorry for dragging my feet with a review, I had made this account a while ago specifically because you have been so great to me and I wanted to recognize you publicly.

Over the years, I have placed dozens of multiple plant orders with Mike. He has been incredibly helpful in terms of finding exactly what I am looking for and answering all of my (sometimes ridiculous) questions. I had been following the forums for a few years before I joined, and was happy to find Mike is just as cool and knowledgeable when interacting one on one. Without trying to sound hyperbolic, Mike has the absolute best North American carnivorous plant collection (plus some) that I am aware of and offers the clear best value in terms of plant quality, size, and price. He is the most diligent and responsible person I know in terms of location data and natural habitats. He is a true plant academic, an absolute treasure in the hobby, and comes with my highest recommendation.

posts.body_html: This post is long overdue and Mike deserves every bit of praise he receives on here. Every part of the process was easy and enjoyable... Where else can you browse a massive selection of sarracenia with location data and get the same level of customer support? Ordering is a breeze! Mike has always been super helpful with any questions, and often offers up other plants based on my order. Sometimes, the plant offered isn't one he has listed. The contents of the packages are well wrapped, clearly marked, and often contain freebies. The plants I have received were in excellent condition and often way bigger than expected, with large divisions that could easily been separated further. Can't wait till spring so I can place another order, till then my wish list keeps growing! Thanks for everything Mike, keep up the amazing work!
